source_note: Level definitions follow the NASA Technology Readiness Assessment Guidelines (NASA/SP-2016-6105, NASA Tech Handbook) and the DoD Technology Readiness Assessment Deskbook (2009); level names align with the NASA TechPort 9-level TRL label space (trlCurrent). This criteria set is a heuristic aid for evidence-driven assessment, not a certification standard.

criteria.guidance: Provide a report of observed basic principles establishing the scientific basis of the technology.
Provide documentation characterizing the underlying physical or scientific phenomenon under study.
Provide a written concept statement or trade study defining the proposed application.

criteria.description: Analytical or experimental verification of the concept approach
criteria.guidance: Provide an analytical model or early experiment verifying the proposed concept approach.

levels.name: Analytical and experimental critical function and/or characteristic proof of concept

criteria.description: Analytical critical function and/or characteristic proof of concept
criteria.guidance: Provide an analysis report demonstrating the critical function or characteristic as a proof of concept.

criteria.description: Experimental laboratory demonstration of the critical function
criteria.guidance: Provide bench test data from a laboratory demonstration of the critical function at component level.

levels.name: Component and/or breadboard validation in laboratory environment

criteria.description: Component and/or breadboard validation in laboratory environment
criteria.guidance: Provide a component or breadboard validation test report executed in a laboratory environment, including acceptance criteria, conditions, and results.
Provide a risk assessment identifying integration risks for combining the validated components.

levels.name: Component and/or breadboard validation in relevant environment

criteria.description: Component and/or breadboard validation in relevant environment
criteria.guidance: Provide component test report executed in a relevant environment, including acceptance criteria, conditions, and results.

criteria.description: Fidelity of the relevant environment justified
criteria.guidance: Provide an environment rationale justifying why the test environment is representative of the operational environment.

levels.name: System/subsystem model or prototype demonstration in a relevant environment

criteria.description: System/subsystem model or prototype demonstration in a relevant environment
criteria.guidance: Provide a prototype demonstration report with results showing the system or subsystem operating under relevant conditions.

criteria.description: Critical operations of the prototype documented
criteria.guidance: Provide documentation of critical prototype operations, including the mission profile exercised.

levels.name: System prototype demonstration in an operational environment

criteria.description: System prototype demonstration in flight/operational environment
criteria.guidance: Provide a flight test report demonstrating the system prototype in a flight environment.
Provide flight readiness review documentation authorizing the prototype demonstration.

levels.name: Actual system completed and qualified through test and demonstration

criteria.description: Actual system completed and flight qualified
criteria.guidance: Provide a qualification report showing the actual system completed and qualified through test and demonstration.
Provide first unit production and test records for the actual system.

levels.name: Actual system proven successful in operation

criteria.description: Actual system proven successful in operation
criteria.guidance: Provide an operational record showing the actual system proven successful in operation.
Provide service history documenting sustained, ongoing operations of the system.
